title: Damp Arch Splodge
tagline: A whole sofa, simmered until it sulks. Stir with great drama.
rhyme:
Splish and splosh and bubble-bump,
In goes a sofa, soggy and slumped.
Drip in a drainpipe, green and long,
Stir in a bagpipe's sulky song.
Seven wellies, wet and squelchy,
One umbrella, inside-out and belchy.
Fetch a shed door, flat and grim,
Add a bridge-shadow, cold and dim.
Stir it thrice and stamp your feet,
The grumbliest splodge you'll ever meet!

ingredients.item: odd wellies, each full of puddle

steps:
Haul the sofa to the cauldron's brim,
Then shove it in till it starts to swim.

Feed in the drainpipe, bus-long and green,
Then seven wellies, the squelchiest seen.

Shake in the umbrella, inside-out,
And bunting by the mile, no doubt.

Slide in the shadow, cold and deep,
Then lean the shed door on top to keep.

Stir it thrice with a grumpy groan,
The splodge is done, and it's all your own.
image_prompt: An enormous black cauldron overflowing with grey-green swampy splodge, a slumped sofa cushion sinking in the middle, a long green drainpipe curling over the rim, seven wellies bobbing on top, limp soggy bunting draped down the sides, and an inside-out umbrella poking out like a wilted flower.
alt_text: A huge cauldron brimming with green-grey sludge, with a sofa cushion, drainpipe, wellies, limp bunting and an inside-out umbrella poking out.
caption_hook:
Today's spell comes from somewhere damp, dark and under a bridge. The sofa went in first and it hasn't stopped sulking.
Which ingredient would you chuck in the cauldron next?
